claim: Rokid Lumen releases beta.19–.21 with cross-app handwriting, notification replies and memory fixes
summary: On October 10, the open-source Rokid Lumen project published three beta prereleases (0.2.0-beta.19, .20 and .21). The developer documents a glasses-wide input method supporting Meta Neural Band handwriting, dictation or companion-phone typing; photo-bearing notifications and custom text replies; band gesture switching; and an always-visible time/battery status bar. Beta.21 also fixes black-blinking web pages caused by overaggressive Gecko memory release. These are developer-published code/release claims and project-supplied hardware evidence, not independently reproduced GlassesResearch tests. The Neural Band link remains unofficial reverse engineering with firmware and security/installation risks documented in the earlier October 8 candidate. No claim that stock Rokid or Meta officially supports the integration.
